purpose: Teach: 中曽根/ドール/ジョーンズ/サード/ハリス/菅/内藤/ダニエル

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 中曽根政権時代の電電公社民営化を社内資料に追加しましょう
lines.en: Let's add the NTT privatization during the Nakasone era to the internal documentation.
lines.style: Efficient, forward-moving tone. Crisp consonants. Professional cadence. Light decisiveness without abruptness. Eyes on the next task.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。米国ドール社のパイナップル取引を再開します
lines.en: Understood. I'll restart the pineapple trade discussions with Dole.
lines.style: Neat confirmation, matching her pace. Steady, reliable. No flourish — just clear acknowledgment and immediate pivot to action.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 英国ジョーンズ社の請求書を確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's verify the invoice from Jones Company in the UK.
lines.style: Same brisk forward momentum. Slightly higher in the register — delegating cleanly. No room for negotiation, but not unkind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。サード・パーティ・ロジスティクスを採用します
lines.en: Understood. I'll implement the third-party logistics system.
lines.style: Confirming note taken. Professional shorthand. The rhythm of a subordinate keeping pace. Warm baseline underneath the efficiency.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 米国のハリス支社、つまりハリス・カンパニーと契約しましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with a contract with the Harris branch in the US — Harris Company.
lines.style: Slight pause for clarification on the company name — she's being thorough, not vague. Then returns to the brisk instructional tone. Expecting immediate understanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。菅取締役の出張日程を整えます
lines.en: Got it. I'll coordinate Director Suga's travel schedule.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient response. No wasted syllables. The sound of someone with a growing list and steady hands. Professional warmth at baseline.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内顧問の内藤先生に新人研修を依頼しましょう
lines.en: Let's ask Naito-sensei, our internal advisor, to lead the new hire training.
lines.style: Respectful addition of the honorific. Still brisk, but a hair more careful — she's speaking about someone senior. Delegating upward requires a different inflection.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。技術担当のダニエル氏との打合せを予定します
lines.en: Understood. I'll set up a meeting with Daniel from the technical team.
lines.style: Final confirmation of the cycle — slightly warmer, acknowledging the last item. Steady completion note. Closes the loop without trailing.
